primary.title: NSC for NRIs: Can non-resident Indians invest in National Savings Certificate and claim tax benefits?
primary.summary: Investments in NSC start at ₹1,000 with no upper limit. NSC qualifies for Section 80C tax deductions for resident investors. Premature encashment is allowed under specific circumstances, like the account holder's death or court orders.
